title: Crispy Delight Fritters
description: A simple and crispy delight fritter recipe, perfect as a snack. Crunchy on the outside, fluffy on the inside.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Mix Delight and starch in a bowl.
Add Fried Delight bits to the bowl and mix well.
Using a spoon, drop small portions of the mixture into the hot oil.
Fry for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
